{{Quote|Please, take this gift.''"<br />"''What is it?''"<br />"''A mimph tooth for your Belt of Honor! Thrasher lost it in a fight.''"<br />"''Gee, thanks, guys. Nobody's going to believe ''this'' when I get home.|A mimph hunting team leader and Wicket|<ref name="gwtm" />}}
'''Thrasher''' was a [[mimph]] who lived on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. Thrasher was missing a [[Tooth/Legends|tooth]], which had been lost in a fight.<ref name="gwtm" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="date">{{EwoksDate|the appearance of Thrasher|[[Gone With the Mimphs]]}}</ref> the mimph helped capture the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Warrick]] and bring him back to the [[mimph village]]. After Warrick helped defeat the [[hanadak]] which had come to the village, Thrasher's tooth was given by a mimph [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] team leader to the Ewok to add to his [[Belt of Honor]]. Thrasher had [[Color/Legends|pink-and-white]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]] and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and wore orange [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] with a yellow [[Belt/Legends|belt]].<ref name="gwtm" />

==Behind the scenes==
Smasher appeared in "[[Gone With the Mimphs]]," the sixth episode of the [[Ewoks: Season Two|second season]] of the animated series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']]. The episode was written by [[Linda Woolverton]]<ref name="gwtm" /> and aired on [[October 18]], [[1986]].<ref name="insider">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
